name: Solar Flare
tagline: Nine Circles rebuilt as a sun — gold, geometry, and a smiling star called Janet.

facts.note: A heavily buffed remake of the 1.9 Nine Circles level Solar Circles. The smiling sun in the level is named Janet.

theme.mood: Molten gold on near-black. A sun disc with a hard corona, radiating sunburst blades, spoked medallions turning like gears, and heavy beveled letters lit white-hot from inside.

voice.hook: A Nine Circles level that became a sun.
voice.why:
Solar Flare takes the most overdone format in the game and makes it feel enormous. It's a remake of Solar Circles, buffed to the point of being a different level entirely, and every part of it is built around one idea — heat.

The gold is what sells it. Most levels that go for orange end up muddy; this one keeps the blacks genuinely black so the gold reads as light rather than paint. And it has a smiling sun named Janet in it, which I think about more than I should.
